from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687584/attempts/b3185891c976479ea5185c4f4f75a2fa/system/state/workspace/programs/task-beb61950.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Full-width/full-height separator lines partition the canvas into panels.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep_color = grid[row_seps[0]][0] if row_seps else grid[0][col_seps[0]]
    rows = []
    r0 = 0
    for r in row_seps + [h]:
        if r > r0:
            rows.append((r0, r))
        r0 = r + 1
    cols = []
    c0 = 0
    for c in col_seps + [w]:
        if c > c0:
            cols.append((c0, c))
        c0 = c + 1
    bg = next(v for v in set(sum(grid, [])) if v != sep_color)
    out = []
    for ra, rb in rows:
        line = []
        for ca, cb in cols:
            counts = {}
            for r in range(ra, rb):
                for c in range(ca, cb):
                    v = grid[r][c]
                    if v != bg and v != sep_color:
                        counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
            line.append(1 if sum(counts.values()) >= 2 else bg)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
